title: scRNA-seq PMBC, PostTx ATL-DC+PolyICLC 27
extract_protocol_ch1: Viably frozen PBMC were thawed, washed with PBS to remove dead cell debris and resuspended to 1,000 cells/µl. The cells were loaded to the Chromium controller for GEM generation 10x Genomics' protocol. We targeted 10,000 sequenced cells. We only selected representative patients from each treatment group whose PBMC cell quality and quantity were sufficient for single cell RNAseq processing.
Sequencing library was constructed per manufacturer's protocol (10x Genomics, 3' scRNAseq)
description: not included in analysis because of bad quality
data_processing: The data was demultiplexed, barcode processed and aligned to the Genome Reference Consortium Human Build 38 (GRCh38)  with Cell Ranger (version 3.1.0).

Data was imported into R (version 4.2.1) and analyzed with the Seurat package (version 4.2.0)63. For quality assurance, cells with greater than 20% mitochondrial features were excluded from further analysis. Sample S27-06-2-Day29 (group: Poly-ICLC) was excluded because of poor sequencing quality.

We analyzed a total of 99,590 cells after the QC step. The Seurat data object from each sample were then integrated and scaled, regressing out the percent mitochondrial features and cell cycle score difference, as described(https://satijalab.org/seurat/index.html).
We manually identified each cluster using the genes that were differentially expressed as determined by FindAllMarker function; they are visualized using R’s ggplot2 and pheatmap packages.

Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) corresponding to each treatment group (Placebo vs. Poly-ICLC vs. resiquimod) were computed by computing DEGs between each group against the pre-treatment (Day 0) samples and we visualized recurrent DEGs using pheatmap.
Assembly: GRCh38
Supplementary files format and content: RDS file of Seurat object containing the QC-ed, integrated, scaled and manually annotated clusters of cells.
Supplementary files format and content: Matrix market-formatted raw gene-level count file
Supplementary files format and content: The list of gene names in the raw gene-level count file
Supplementary files format and content: The list of cell barcodes in the raw gene-level count file

The cells were loaded to the Chromium controller for GEM generation 10x Genomics' protocol. We targeted 10,000 sequenced cells. We only selected representative patients from each treatment group whose PBMC cell quality and quantity were sufficient for single cell RNAseq processing.
Sequencing library was constructed per manufacturer's protocol (10x Genomics, 3' scRNAseq)
data_processing: The data was demultiplexed, barcode processed and aligned to the Genome Reference Consortium Human Build 38 (GRCh38)  with Cell Ranger (version 3.1.0).

Data was imported into R (version 4.2.1) and analyzed with the Seurat package (version 4.2.0)63. For quality assurance, cells with greater than 20% mitochondrial features were excluded from further analysis. Sample S27-06-2-Day29 (group: Poly-ICLC) was excluded because of poor sequencing quality.

We analyzed a total of 99,590 cells after the QC step. The Seurat data object from each sample were then integrated and scaled, regressing out the percent mitochondrial features and cell cycle score difference, as described(https://satijalab.org/seurat/index.html).
We manually identified each cluster using the genes that were differentially expressed as determined by FindAllMarker function; they are visualized using R’s ggplot2 and pheatmap packages.

Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) corresponding to each treatment group (Placebo vs. Poly-ICLC vs. resiquimod) were computed by computing DEGs between each group against the pre-treatment (Day 0) samples and we visualized recurrent DEGs using pheatmap.
Assembly: GRCh38
Supplementary files format and content: RDS file of Seurat object containing the QC-ed, integrated, scaled and manually annotated clusters of cells.
Supplementary files format and content: Matrix market-formatted raw gene-level count file
Supplementary files format and content: The list of gene names in the raw gene-level count file
Supplementary files format and content: The list of cell barcodes in the raw gene-level count file

unmatched_original_GEO_records.reason: Original patient27PostTxrecord has no author sample ID or deposited count-barcode cells; do not fabricate an observation or infer its expression.

metadata.source_count_semantics: Deposited integerRNAUMIcounts on the published native gene axis and authorQCcell cohort. Authorintegrated/scaled assays are not used. Retain observed differences from authorRNAmetadata instead of forcing equality.
metadata.source_gene_policy: All15807deposited gene-symbol coordinates retained. Additional genes absent from this deposited matrix remain unavailable; no inventedEnsemblIDs or zero-filled outer gene axis.
metadata.source_identity_policy: Exact deposited barcode-to-authorIDjoin; sourceSxxpatient code and Day0/Day29labels match literalGEOpatient numbers and Pre/Posttitles. Healthy donor names match literalGEOdonor numbers. Numeric barcode suffixes never assign donors.
metadata.source_donor_policy: Retain full patientIDstem across repeated visits and full healthy donorID. Unknown internal ID numbers are opaque; never infer age, sex, dose or treatment from them.
metadata.source_treatment_policy: AuthorTx_Group is assigned arm, including before treatment. PreTXis not postexposure. Preserve originalGEOtreatment and authorarm/time fields separately.
metadata.source_timing_policy: Day0/Day29are nominal author identifiers, not exact verified draw timestamps.
metadata.source_clinical_policy: Age/sex, tumor grade, mutation, outcome and exact draw timestamps unjoined. Internal sourceIDnumbers remain opaque; do not infer covariates from them.
metadata.source_missing_observation_policy: GSM7633503patient27PostTxhas no source cells and is not a zero-expression specimen.
metadata.source_QC_policy: Common500RNAUMI/200genes/20percentMTQC on the deposited15807gene axis. Original99590cells reflect authorQCscope; no force-matching retained cells to publication total.
metadata.source_author_annotation_policy: Original celltype/cluster/cell-cycle fields are comparison metadata only. Integrated/scaled author assays and cell-cycle regression do not enter gene-expression geometry.
metadata.source_literal_metadata_policy: Reviewed importer preserves literalNone/NA/null strings; empty CSV fields remain missing.
metadata.source_split_policy: Unassigned. All visits of one source donor must share a split; independent study validation and global donor alias audits remain required.
